text: Found why the engine runs badly: a watchdog I added today (TCL76d) is killing it. Every job since 12:08 UTC ended 'engine ended: STALL' at ~7.5 min, 24 times in a row, so every scan restarts cold and the fair odds are ~12 min old. It is a false alarm: the loop's heartbeat tick stalls ~60 s in while bids, trading and feeds keep working. Fix in progress: bound the read-only steps of that loop to 60 s, and make the watchdog count log activity as alive (hard cap 10 min of true silence). Building and testing now.
